answer_1.quote: we design a controlled LLM probing experiment... the model must write a short paragraph about each entity... We run two variants: with an explicitly supplied name (GEN_W) and without a name (GEN_WO)... Comparing these variants reveals whether encountering a potentially 'real' name alters honorific choice... translation tasks (TR_W and TR_WO).
datasets: 10,000 Wikipedia articles each for Hindi and Bengali
answer_1.outputs: Short paragraphs about entities in Hindi/Bengali

answer_2.quote: GPT-4o achieved the highest agreement with human annotations indicated by Cohen's kappa coefficient and percentage agreement: κ = 0.47 (BN: 85%) and κ = 0.78 (HI: 93%)... The agreement between the human annotators was even greater: BN: κ = 0.89 (98%) and HI: κ = 0.97 (99%)

answer_4.quote: validated by native speakers on 100 randomly selected articles per language... both the authors and human annotators manually validated a random subset... Our annotation process involved four native speakers, two of Hindi and two of Bengali... We instructed the annotators to indicate their preferred usage
answer_4.guideline: 'If you were writing an article (Wikipedia-style article or blog post intended for a general online audience) about the same entity... what kind of pronouns/verbs would you use? (Honorific/Non-Honorific)'
